finalText:
**Redis died, and the cache loss took the service with it.**

At `02:14:07` `[api]` logged `redis connection lost: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379`. Cache went to direct store reads. No successful request logged after `02:14:03`.

| Time | Event |
|---|---|
| 02:14:07 | Redis refused, cache degraded |
| 02:14:10+ | 173 `TimeoutError` after 5000ms |
| 02:15:26–02:31:26 | 13 reconnect attempts, all `ECONNREFUSED` |
| 02:31:44 | `worker-2` heap out of memory, code 134 |
| 02:31:52 | `FATAL [supervisor] api unresponsive` |

Queue depth climbed 52 to 568 against a max of 500. Redis never came back.

Next: check why `10.0.0.12:6379` refused connections, and cap the queue so a cache outage sheds load instead of filling the heap.
